reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Notes autosave and loading
reason: Notes edits now debounce to durable Core observations while preserving responsive local typing, revision checks, failure retry, and selection. Fourteen collected component cases cover the editor states. Eight permanent browser profiles cover the Notes screen and mobile geometry. The selected production LAN real-Core case proves an edit persists through reload without pressing Save.
exclusions: No Python or native behavior changed. Unrelated UI, API, provider, harness, and full suites are excluded. The existing loading-progress component case and Notes screen browser case cover navigation feedback. Physical-device testing is unavailable locally and is reported separately.
